name: shaded
description: Single-file WebGL landing/app experience for SHADED.

scripts.check: node --check tools/verify.js && node --check tools/verify-actors.js && node --check tools/verify-editor.js && node --check tools/register.js && node --check tools/orchestrate.js && node --check editor/facade.js && node --check editor/facade.test.js && node --check editor/markerPainter.js && node --check editor/actorPlacer.js && node --check editor/storyboardTimeline.js && node --check editor/app.js && node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('contracts/shaded-scene-project.schema.json','utf8'))" && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const h=fs.readFileSync('index.html','utf8'); const m=h.match(/<script>([\s\S]*)<\/script>/); if(!m) throw new Error('index.html script tag not found'); new Function(m[1]); console.log('index script parses')" && npm run check:rendergraph
scripts.check:rendergraph: node --check rendergraph/rendergraph.js && python3 tools/shaded_rendergraph.py && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const h=fs.readFileSync('rendergraph/demo.html','utf8'); const scripts=[...h.matchAll(/<script(?:\s+src=\"[^\"]+\")?>([\s\S]*?)<\/script>/g)].map(m=>m[1]).filter(Boolean); scripts.forEach(s=>new Function(s)); console.log('rendergraph demo scripts parse')"
